description: Connect to China Galaxy Securities XingYao Data Intelligence platform: A-share / ETF / convertible bond / options / futures quotes, K-line charts, financial statements, shareholder structure, margin trading, dragon-tiger list, index constituents and treasury yields. The runtime is installed automatically on first connection (about 3-5 minutes). Supports Windows; macOS is not supported yet.

connector.description_en: Connect to China Galaxy Securities XingYao Data Intelligence platform: A-share / ETF / convertible bond / options / futures quotes, K-line charts, financial statements, shareholder structure, margin trading, dragon-tiger list, index constituents and treasury yields. The runtime is installed automatically on first connection (about 3-5 minutes). Supports Windows; macOS is not supported yet.
connector.description_zh: 连接中国银河证券星耀数智平台，查询A股/ETF/可转债/期权/期货行情、K线、财务报表、股东结构、两融、龙虎榜、指数成分与国债收益率等数据。首次连接自动安装运行环境（约3~5分钟），安装期间请勿重复点击连接。当前版本支持 Windows，macOS 暂不支持。
